date.as_written: bhādraśukle caturthyāṃ tu śaśivāre ca vāyubhe

notes: Following the manuscript ownership statement (pustakam idaṃ ... śrīkṛṣṇajośī), the colophon records the astrological birth details of a son: 'bhādraśukle caturthyāṃ tu śaśivāre ca vāyubhe || siṃhalagne paṃcaśubhagrahayukto bhavat sutaḥ'.
